scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Good day. My name is Leablem,
and I'm a technician that specializes in
adding slots to weapons and armors.
It can be very hard sometimes, but I like
what I do, and take pride in it.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您好，我叫利阿布雷姆，是一名專門為武器和防具新增插槽的技師。
這活兒有時很難，但我喜歡自己的工作，也為它感到自豪。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
I've learned most of the things from my brother, Seyablem,
but I think I still have a lot to learn.
So please understand my slotting services are limited,
unlike my brother Seyablem.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
我的手藝大多是哥哥賽亞佈雷姆教的，不過，我還有很多要學的地方。
所以，我能提供的開槽服務不像哥哥那麼多，還請您諒解。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
My brother wasn't so happy to teach me
his skills because he was worried that his skills
wouldn't be unique anymore. He did, however, his best
to teach me.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
哥哥原本不太願意傳授手藝，怕教會了我，他的技術就不再獨一無二了。
不過，他還是盡心盡力地教了我。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Thanks to him, I've learned lots of things.
I'm not very confident
in trying many different things,
but I'll do what
I can do for now.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
多虧了他，我學會了不少東西。
雖然我還沒信心嘗試太多新東西，但眼下能做的事，我都會盡力做好。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
In fact, there's one thing
that my brother doesn't want me to do.
I don't want to upset him, so...let's just skip that part.
I'll say no more about it!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
其實，有一件事哥哥不想讓我做。
我不想惹他生氣，所以...還是跳過這件事吧。
不說了！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Anyways, do you have any equipment
which you'd like to add to the slots?
My service charge, the materials,
and the success chance all depend on
the specific item I'm working on.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
總之，您有沒有想新增插槽的裝備？
服務費、所需材料和成功率，都取決於具體的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Weapon, you said? Sure, no problem.
Weapons are divided into 4 different class
depending on the work difficulty.
C class is the easiest one, and S class is the hardest one.
Which class would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
武器，是嗎？當然，沒問題。
我會根據加工難度，把武器分成4個等級。
C級最容易，S級最難。
您想嘗試哪個等級？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
C class, I see.
So, what kind of weapon do you have?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
C級啊，明白了。
那麼，您帶了什麼武器？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
You have chosen average B class.
So, what kind of weapon do you have?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您選擇了難度適中的B級。
那麼，您帶了什麼武器？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
A class? You seem to want little too much. But, no problem.
So, what kind of weapon do you have?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
A級？您的要求有點高啊。
不過，沒問題。
那麼，您帶了什麼武器？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Huh, S Class?! Oh my god, are you serious?*Tremble*
So...which S class weapon would you like to make a slot?!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
什麼，S級？！天哪，您是認真的嗎？*發抖*
那麼...您想為哪把S級武器新增插槽？！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Armor, you said? Sure, no problem.
Armors are divided into 4 different class
depending on the work difficulty.
C class is the easiest one, and S class is the hardest one.
Which class would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
防具，是嗎？當然，沒問題。
我會根據加工難度，把防具分成4個等級。
C級最容易，S級最難。
您想嘗試哪個等級？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
C class, I see.
So, what kind of armor do you have?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
C級啊，明白了。
那麼，您帶了什麼防具？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
You have chosen average B class.
So, what kind of armor do you have?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您選擇了難度適中的B級。
那麼，您帶了什麼防具？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
A class? You seem to want little too much. But, no problem.
So, what kind of armor do you have?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
A級？您的要求有點高啊。
不過，沒問題。
那麼，您帶了什麼防具？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Huh, S Class?! Oh my god, are you serious?*Tremble*
So...which S class armor would you like to make a slot?!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
什麼，S級？！天哪，您是認真的嗎？*發抖*
那麼...您想為哪件S級防具新增插槽？！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Oh, it's nothing special, but he thinks
it's not something for humans to mess with. 
I don't want to upset my brother,
so I'd better forget about it.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
哦，也沒什麼特別的，只是哥哥覺得那不是人類該插手的事。
我不想惹他生氣，還是忘了吧。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
...That service itself has a very high success chance,
but requires a lot of materials and a high-rate service charge.
I highly doubt that anyone would actually want to use
the service, even if I did open it.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
...那項服務的成功率很高，但需要大量材料，服務費也很貴。
就算我真的提供這項服務，我也很懷疑會不會有人願意用。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
You seem interested in using that service.
If you want, I can at least tell you about it.
But you must promise to keep this a secret.
If my brother finds out what I'm about to tell you,
he's gonna give me a beating!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
看來您對那項服務很感興趣。
要是您想聽，我倒是可以說說。
不過，您必須答應替我保密。
哥哥要是知道我把這事告訴您，肯定會揍我一頓！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
This special service has a 90% success chance,
but requires 2 Gold and 2 hundred million zeny:
I can add slots to the Hat of the Sun God.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
這項特殊服務的成功率是90%，但需要2個黃金和2億Zeny。
我可以為太陽神頭盔新增插槽。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
My brother said that, even since ancient times, it's forbidden to modify that hat.
But I believe humans are too curious not to
experiment, especially when it's forbidden.
I just don't want my brother to yell at me. That's all.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
哥哥說，自古以來就禁止改造那頂帽子。
可我覺得，人類的好奇心太強了，越是被禁止的事，就越想嘗試。
我只是不想挨哥哥的罵罷了。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
...Wh... What? No!
Giving me that dirty look
won't make me do it!
No, I said no! No is no! No!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
...什...什麼？不行！
您這樣瞪著我，我也不會答應！
不行，我說了不行！不行就是不行！不行！

[利阿布雷姆]
不，我不幹！不行！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
You're so persistent. Okay, I'll make you an exception.
Just don't tell anyone,
especially my brother. Do you promise?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您還真是執著。
好吧，我就為您破例一次。
不過，千萬別告訴任何人，尤其是我哥哥。
您能保證嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Okay then, please bring me
^FF00002 Gold, 2 hundred million zeny -- the service charge --,
^FF0000and a Hat of the Sun God.
^FF0000You know your chance of success is 90% with this, don't you?^000000
We don't have time to waste,
so let's get down to business right away.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
好，請帶來^FF00002個黃金和2億Zeny的服務費，
^FF0000還有一頂太陽神頭盔。
^FF0000您知道這次的成功率是90%，對吧？^000000
別浪費時間了，我們馬上開工。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Shall we start now?
Pray to your gods for good luck.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
現在開始吧？
向您的神明祈禱好運吧。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Excellent! Wow, I guess the 90% success chance is true!
Look, the slot was added in the perfect place.
Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
太棒了！哇，看來90%的成功率是真的！
看，插槽的位置恰到好處。
恭喜您。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
This is the first and last time I will do this for you.
Don't ever tell anyone
about this. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
這是我第一次，也是最後一次為您做這件事。
千萬別告訴任何人，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Wah! Oh my god, we failed!
My god, I guess we had the worst kind of luck...
What should we do? ...This is why
I didn't want to do in the first place!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
哇！天哪，我們失敗了！
天哪，看來我們的運氣真是糟透了...
這可怎麼辦？...所以我一開始才不想做啊！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
No, don't ever ask me to do such a risky thing again!
Bah~
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
不，以後絕對不要再讓我做這種危險的事了！
哼~

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
You don't have enough materials.
Man, why did you even ask me to try?
I'm not going to do this again for you,
even if you bring enough materials. Bah~
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您的材料不夠。
真是的，沒帶齊材料，幹嗎還讓我試？
就算您把材料帶齊，我也不會再幫您做了。
哼~

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Don't ever tell anyone
about what I told you. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
我告訴您的事，千萬別向別人透露，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Do you want to know more information?
Well, I don't think there's something
that you specifically need to know.
But I can at least give you a tip.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您還想了解更多？
嗯，我覺得也沒什麼非知道不可的事。
不過，我倒是可以給您一個小提示。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
The slot technicians in each town
provide different slotting success chances
depending on your equipment's upgrade level.
I don't know if that's true,
but I can see the difference in each town.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
各城鎮的開槽技師，開槽成功率會隨著裝備的精煉等級而有所不同。
我也不確定是不是這樣，但確實能看出各城鎮之間的差別。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
For instance, a slot technician in one town
provides a higher success chance to
equipment items at higher upgrade levels,
while a technician in another town has higher
success at lower upgrade levels.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
比如，有的城鎮裡，技師給精煉等級高的裝備開槽，成功率更高。
而另一些城鎮的技師，給精煉等級低的裝備開槽，成功率反而更高。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
When you fail to add a slot, the equipment
will become broken and disappear.
I try my best to succeed, but
slotting is complicated work.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
開槽一旦失敗，裝備就會損壞並消失。
我會盡力爭取成功，但開槽畢竟是項複雜的工作。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Oh, there's an important thing that you need to be careful about.
^FF0000Try not to carry two identical equipment items
^FF0000with you when you add slots.
^FF0000Otherwise, slots may be added to one of the randomly chosen items,
^FF0000and in the worst case, you may lose an item that is more valuable to you.^000000
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
哦，還有件重要的事要提醒您。
^FF0000開槽時，儘量不要隨身攜帶兩件^FF0000相同的裝備。
^FF0000否則，我可能會隨機選中其中一件來開槽，^FF0000最壞的情況下，您會失去那件更珍貴的裝備。^000000

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
I hope this information will be helpful to you.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
希望這些資訊對您有幫助。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
{0}... Okay, then you need to bring me
^FF0000{1},000 zeny as service charge,
^FF0000{2}ea {3} and {4}ea {5}.
^FF0000Of course, you need a {6}.^000000

[Leablem]
{0}? Okay, then you need to bring me
^FF0000{1},000 zeny as service charge and {2} {3}{4} as the requirement.
^FF0000Of course, don't forget to bring me a {5}.
^FF0000You should have all items.^000000
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
{0}？好，請帶來^FF0000{1},000 Zeny的服務費，以及所需的{2} {3}{4}。
^FF0000當然，別忘了帶上{5}。
^FF0000所有物品都要備齊。^000000

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Did you already bring all of them?
For your information, if you fail to create a slot,
you will lose all the item requirement as well as the target {0}.
Also remember, if the {1} has been upgraded, and has been inserted with a card,
you will lose them even if you succeed in creating a slot.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您已經帶齊了嗎？
先說明一下，開槽一旦失敗，所有材料和要開槽的{0}都會消失。
另外，如果{1}已經精煉過，並且鑲嵌了卡片，即使開槽成功，精煉等級和卡片也會消失。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Alright then, let the work begin!
You'd better pray for a successful result.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
好，那就開工吧！
祈禱這次能成功吧。

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Great, it seems to be successful.
It looks pretty well done. Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
太好了，看來成功了。
做得還不錯，恭喜您！

[利阿布雷姆]
下次見，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Wah! ...I am so sorry, it failed.
However, I am completely innocent.
This is your luck, and it is destined by god, okay?
Don't be so disappointed,
and try next time.
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
哇！...真抱歉，失敗了。
不過，這可不能怪我。
這得看您的運氣，成敗都是上天註定的，明白嗎？
別太失望，下次再試吧。

[利阿布雷姆]
下次見，朋友！

scripts.text:
[Leablem]
Are you stupid or what? You didn't bring all of the required items!
Go bring them quick!
scripts.translation:
[利阿布雷姆]
您是笨蛋嗎？需要的東西都沒帶齊！
快去拿來！
